say:6:1720955004:1.text: Sure. One of Viscount Demit's servants. Said he had a friend at the paper and wanted to help get it into more shops.

say:7:1720955005:1.text: He paid me a little every month to leave copies out. Easy money. Hard to say no to that.

say:9:1720955006:1.text: So you're admitting you took money from Viscount Demit's servant.

say:10:1720955007:1.text: C-Commander?! What are you doing here?!

say:11:1720955008:1.text: We're investigating a major conspiracy against the royal court, and Viscount Demit is one of the suspects. We have reason to believe you may be harboring a wanted man.

say:12:1720955009:1.text: This is your last chance to come clean and earn yourself some leniency.
say:12:1720955009:1.source_cn: 现在坦白你所知道的一切，是你将功赎罪的最后机会。
